**Walmart** had the higher operating margin in fiscal 2026, by roughly 0.4 percentage points. This is a best estimate from memory, not from the filings, and Costco's fiscal 2026 had not ended when I last had data.

- **Walmart (fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2026):** operating income of roughly $29.8B on revenue of roughly $713B, which is a margin of about 4.2%.
- **Costco (fiscal year ending Aug 2026):** its latest full year (fiscal 2025) was about 3.8%, and fiscal 2026 quarters so far have run at a similar level, so I assume about 3.8%.

The gap is therefore about 4.2% − 3.8% ≈ 0.4 percentage points.
